<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<title>Flotter</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400;9..144,500;9..144,600&family=Karla:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg: #EDF2EE;
    --surface: #FFFFFF;
    --surface-2: #E2EAE4;
    --ink: #223229;
    --ink-soft: #5B6B61;
    --accent: #4C7A6B;
    --accent-deep: #33564A;
    --accent-soft: #BFD8CC;
    --lavender: #8C86AC;
    --line: rgba(34,50,41,0.12);
    --shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(34,50,41,0.08);
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
      --bg: #16211C;
      --surface: #1D2B24;
      --surface-2: #24352C;
      --ink: #E9F0EA;
      --ink-soft: #A9BBAF;
      --accent: #86B7A3;
      --accent-deep: #A9CFBF;
      --accent-soft: #2E453B;
      --lavender: #ADA6D6;
      --line: rgba(233,240,234,0.12);
      --shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    }
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"]{
    --bg: #16211C;
    --surface: #1D2B24;
    --surface-2: #24352C;
    --ink: #E9F0EA;
    --ink-soft: #A9BBAF;
    --accent: #86B7A3;
    --accent-deep: #A9CFBF;
    --accent-soft: #2E453B;
    --lavender: #ADA6D6;
    --line: rgba(233,240,234,0.12);
    --shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
  }
  *{ box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body{ height: 100%; }
  html{ scroll-padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); }
  body{
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }
  h1, h2, h3, .display{
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    margin: 0;
  }
  .app{
    max-width: 480px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    min-height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
  }
  header.top{
    padding: 22px 22px 14px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
  header.top .brand{
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .mark{
    width: 26px; height: 26px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, var(--accent-soft), var(--accent) 70%);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  header.top h1{ font-size: 1.35rem; color: var(--ink); }
  .theme-toggle{
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: var(--surface);
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    padding: 6px 11px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  main{
    flex: 1;
    padding: 4px 22px 110px;
  }
  .view{ display: none; animation: fadein 0.35s ease; }
  .view.active{ display: block; }
  @keyframes fadein{ from{ opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px);} to{opacity:1; transform:none;} }

  /* ACCUEIL */
  .intro{
    font-size: 0.98rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    margin: 4px 0 26px;
    max-width: 40ch;
  }
  .pillars{
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .pillar{
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 18px 18px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .pillar-head{
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .pillar-title{
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .pillar-num{
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--accent-soft);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    width: 28px;
  }
  .pillar-title h2{ font-size: 1.08rem; }
  .chev{
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    transition: transform 0.25s ease;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .pillar.open .chev{ transform: rotate(180deg); }
  .pillar-body{
    max-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: max-height 0.35s ease;
  }
  .pillar.open .pillar-body{ max-height: 300px; }
  .pillar-body p{
    margin: 14px 0 4px;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    padding-left: 40px;
  }

  .quiet-note{
    margin-top: 26px;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: var(--surface-2);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }

  /* RESPIRER */
  .breathe-wrap{
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding-top: 18px;
  }
  .breathe-stage{
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    max-width: 280px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
  }
  .ring{
    position: absolute;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .ring.r1{ width: 100%; height: 100%; }
  .ring.r2{ width: 76%; height: 76%; }
  .orb{
    width: 42%;
    height: 42%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, var(--accent-soft), var(--accent) 75%);
    transition: transform 4s ease-in-out;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
  .orb.grow{ transform: scale(1.55); }
  .orb.shrink{ transform: scale(1); }
  .breathe-label{
    margin-top: 26px;
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    text-align: center;
    min-height: 1.6em;
  }
  .breathe-sub{
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    margin-top: 6px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .breathe-controls{
    margin-top: 30px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  button.pill{
    font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    border-radius: 24px;
    padding: 11px 20px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: var(--surface);
    color: var(--ink);
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  button.pill.primary{
    background: var(--accent-deep);
    color: var(--surface);
    border-color: var(--accent-deep);
  }

  /* SOS */
  .sos-screen{
    min-height: calc(100vh - 200px);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    gap: 22px;
  }
  .sos-affirm{
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    max-width: 26ch;
    min-height: 4.4em;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: opacity 0.6s ease;
  }
  .sos-tag{
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size: 0.82rem;
  }
  .sos-cta{ margin-top: 6px; }

  /* JOURNAL */
  .journal-form{
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 18px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  }
  .mood-row{
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 6px;
    margin: 14px 0 18px;
  }
  .mood-btn{
    flex: 1;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: var(--surface-2);
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .mood-btn.selected{
    background: var(--accent-deep);
    border-color: var(--accent-deep);
    color: var(--surface);
  }
  textarea{
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 12px;
    font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    resize: vertical;
    min-height: 70px;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .entries{
    margin-top: 22px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .entry{
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 13px 15px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .entry .mood-mark{ font-size: 1.2rem; }
  .entry .meta{
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    margin-bottom: 3px;
  }
  .entry .txt{ font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.45; }
  .entry .del{
    margin-left: auto;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .empty{
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 30px 10px;
  }

  /* NAV */
  nav.tabbar{
    position: fixed;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    bottom: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    width: calc(100% - 32px);
    max-width: 448px;
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 22px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    display: flex;
    padding: 6px;
  }
  nav.tabbar button{
    flex: 1;
    border: none;
    background: none;
    padding: 10px 4px 8px;
    font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  nav.tabbar button.active{
    background: var(--surface-2);
    color: var(--accent-deep);
  }
  nav.tabbar svg{ width: 20px; height: 20px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">

  <header class="top">
    <div class="brand">
      <div class="mark"></div>
      <h1>Flotter</h1>
    </div>
    <button class="theme-toggle" id="themeToggle">Mode nuit</button>
  </header>

  <main>

    <!-- ACCUEIL -->
    <section class="view active" id="view-accueil">
      <p class="intro">Quatre repères simples, inspirés de la méthode de Claire Weekes, pour traverser une vague d'angoisse au lieu de la combattre.</p>
      <div class="pillars" id="pillars"></div>
      <div class="quiet-note">Ces repères ne remplacent pas un avis médical ou psychologique. En cas de détresse importante ou persistante, parles-en à un professionnel de santé.</div>
    </section>

    <!-- RESPIRER -->
    <section class="view" id="view-respirer">
      <div class="breathe-wrap">
        <div class="breathe-stage">
          <div class="ring r1"></div>
          <div class="ring r2"></div>
          <div class="orb" id="orb"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="breathe-label" id="breathLabel">Prêt·e quand tu l'es</div>
        <div class="breathe-sub" id="breathSub">Une respiration lente et régulière, sans forcer.</div>
        <div class="breathe-controls">
          <button class="pill primary" id="breathStart">Commencer</button>
          <button class="pill" id="breathStop">Arrêter</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- SOS -->
    <section class="view" id="view-sos">
      <div class="sos-screen">
        <div class="sos-affirm" id="sosText"></div>
        <div class="sos-tag">Laisse cette phrase s'installer, respire, et laisse la vague passer.</div>
        <button class="pill primary sos-cta" id="sosBreathe">Respirer maintenant</button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- JOURNAL -->
    <section class="view" id="view-journal">
      <div class="journal-form">
        <h2 style="font-size:1.05rem;">Comment te sens-tu ?</h2>
        <div class="mood-row" id="moodRow"></div>
        <textarea id="journalNote" placeholder="Une phrase sur ce moment, si tu en as envie (facultatif)"></textarea>
        <div style="margin-top:14px; display:flex; justify-content:flex-end;">
          <button class="pill primary" id="saveEntry">Enregistrer</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="entries" id="entries"></div>
    </section>

  </main>

  <nav class="tabbar" id="tabbar">
    <button data-view="accueil" class="active">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M4 11.5 12 4l8 7.5"/><path d="M6 10v9h12v-9"/></svg>
      Accueil
    </button>
    <button data-view="respirer">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="7.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.6"/></svg>
      Respirer
    </button>
    <button data-view="sos">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M12 3c-4 4-7 7.5-7 11a7 7 0 0 0 14 0c0-3.5-3-7-7-11Z"/></svg>
      SOS
    </button>
    <button data-view="journal">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M6 4h9l3 3v13H6z"/><path d="M9 9h6M9 13h6M9 17h4"/></svg>
      Journal
    </button>
  </nav>

</div>

<script>
(function(){

  // ---------- DATA ----------
  var pillars = [
    {
      title: "Faire face",
      text: "Plutôt que de fuir la sensation ou de la repousser, tu la regardes en face, telle qu'elle est. Fuir demande de l'énergie et nourrit la peur ; se tourner vers la sensation, calmement, commence déjà à désamorcer la spirale."
    },
    {
      title: "Accepter",
      text: "Une fois la sensation regardée en face, il s'agit de cesser de lutter contre elle. Le corps en état d'alerte s'apaise plus vite quand on arrête de se battre contre ce qu'on ressent, même si c'est inconfortable."
    },
    {
      title: "Flotter",
      text: "Imagine que tu te laisses porter au-dessus de la sensation, comme sur l'eau, plutôt que de te raidir pour lui résister. Ce relâchement musculaire et mental aide la vague d'angoisse à suivre son cours plus vite."
    },
    {
      title: "Laisser le temps passer",
      text: "La guérison ne se force pas, elle se laisse du temps. Une sensation désagréable finit toujours par redescendre. Inutile de guetter le progrès minute par minute : le temps fait le travail, à son rythme."
    }
  ];

  var affirmations = [
    "Ce que tu ressens est inconfortable, pas dangereux.",
    "Tu n'as rien à combattre. Laisse la vague monter, puis redescendre.",
    "Tu as déjà traversé ce genre de moment. Ton corps sait comment revenir au calme.",
    "Rien à résoudre maintenant. Juste respirer, et attendre que ça passe.",
    "Desserre les épaules, desserre la mâchoire. Laisse le corps se relâcher.",
    "Cette sensation a un début et une fin. Tu es déjà en train de la traverser.",
    "Pas besoin d'aller mieux tout de suite. Juste être là, un instant après l'autre."
  ];

  var moods = ["😣","😟","😐","🙂","😌"];

  // ---------- STORAGE ----------
  var STORE_KEY = "flotter_journal_v1";
  function loadEntries(){
    try{
      var raw = localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    }catch(e){ return []; }
  }
  function saveEntries(list){
    try{ localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)); }catch(e){}
  }

  // ---------- RENDER PILLARS ----------
  var pillarsEl = document.getElementById('pillars');
  pillars.forEach(function(p, i){
    var div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'pillar';
    div.innerHTML =
      '<div class="pillar-head">'+
        '<div class="pillar-title"><span class="pillar-num">'+(i+1)+'</span><h2>'+p.title+'</h2></div>'+
        '<svg class="chev" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="pillar-body"><p>'+p.text+'</p></div>';
    div.addEventListener('click', function(){ div.classList.toggle('open'); });
    pillarsEl.appendChild(div);
  });

  // ---------- NAV ----------
  var views = document.querySelectorAll('.view');
  var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('#tabbar button');
  function showView(name){
    views.forEach(function(v){ v.classList.toggle('active', v.id === 'view-'+name); });
    tabs.forEach(function(t){ t.classList.toggle('active', t.dataset.view === name); });
    if(name === 'sos'){ startSOS(); } else { stopSOS(); }
    if(name !== 'respirer'){ stopBreathing(); }
  }
  tabs.forEach(function(t){
    t.addEventListener('click', function(){ showView(t.dataset.view); });
  });
  document.getElementById('sosBreathe').addEventListener('click', function(){ showView('respirer'); });

  // ---------- THEME ----------
  var themeBtn = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
  function applyTheme(mode){
    if(mode){ document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', mode); }
    else { document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme'); }
    themeBtn.textContent = (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark') ? 'Mode jour' : 'Mode nuit';
  }
  var savedTheme = null;
  try{ savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('flotter_theme'); }catch(e){}
  applyTheme(savedTheme);
  themeBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var current = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
    var next = current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    applyTheme(next);
    try{ localStorage.setItem('flotter_theme', next); }catch(e){}
  });

  // ---------- BREATHING ----------
  var orb = document.getElementById('orb');
  var breathLabel = document.getElementById('breathLabel');
  var breathSub = document.getElementById('breathSub');
  var breathTimer = null, breathStep = 0;
  var steps = [
    {label:"Inspire", sub:"Doucement, par le nez", dur:4000, grow:true},
    {label:"Retiens", sub:"Sans crisper", dur:2000, grow:true},
    {label:"Expire", sub:"Longuement, par la bouche", dur:5000, grow:false},
    {label:"Repos", sub:"Une petite pause", dur:2000, grow:false}
  ];
  function runStep(){
    var s = steps[breathStep % steps.length];
    breathLabel.textContent = s.label;
    breathSub.textContent = s.sub;
    orb.style.transitionDuration = s.dur + 'ms';
    orb.classList.toggle('grow', s.grow);
    orb.classList.toggle('shrink', !s.grow);
    breathStep++;
    breathTimer = setTimeout(runStep, s.dur);
  }
  document.getElementById('breathStart').addEventListener('click', function(){
    stopBreathing();
    breathStep = 0;
    runStep();
  });
  document.getElementById('breathStop').addEventListener('click', stopBreathing);
  function stopBreathing(){
    if(breathTimer){ clearTimeout(breathTimer); breathTimer = null; }
    orb.style.transitionDuration = '4s';
    orb.classList.remove('grow');
    orb.classList.add('shrink');
    breathLabel.textContent = "Prêt·e quand tu l'es";
    breathSub.textContent = "Une respiration lente et régulière, sans forcer.";
  }

  // ---------- SOS ----------
  var sosEl = document.getElementById('sosText');
  var sosTimer = null, sosIdx = 0;
  function showAffirm(){
    sosEl.style.opacity = 0;
    setTimeout(function(){
      sosEl.textContent = affirmations[sosIdx % affirmations.length];
      sosIdx++;
      sosEl.style.opacity = 1;
    }, 300);
  }
  function startSOS(){
    sosIdx = Math.floor(Math.random()*affirmations.length);
    showAffirm();
    sosTimer = setInterval(showAffirm, 6000);
  }
  function stopSOS(){
    if(sosTimer){ clearInterval(sosTimer); sosTimer = null; }
  }

  // ---------- JOURNAL ----------
  var moodRow = document.getElementById('moodRow');
  var selectedMood = null;
  moods.forEach(function(m, i){
    var b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'mood-btn';
    b.textContent = m;
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){
      selectedMood = i;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(moodRow.children, function(c){ c.classList.remove('selected'); });
      b.classList.add('selected');
    });
    moodRow.appendChild(b);
  });

  var entriesEl = document.getElementById('entries');
  function renderEntries(){
    var list = loadEntries();
    entriesEl.innerHTML = '';
    if(list.length === 0){
      entriesEl.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Aucune note pour l\'instant. Ton journal apparaîtra ici.</div>';
      return;
    }
    list.slice().reverse().forEach(function(e){
      var div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'entry';
      var d = new Date(e.date);
      var dateStr = d.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', {day:'numeric', month:'short'}) + ' · ' + d.toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR', {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'});
      div.innerHTML =
        '<div class="mood-mark">'+moods[e.mood]+'</div>'+
        '<div style="flex:1;"><div class="meta">'+dateStr+'</div>'+
        (e.note ? '<div class="txt">'+escapeHtml(e.note)+'</div>' : '')+
        '</div>'+
        '<button class="del">Suppr.</button>';
      div.querySelector('.del').addEventListener('click', function(){
        var all = loadEntries();
        var idx = all.findIndex(function(x){ return x.id === e.id; });
        if(idx > -1){ all.splice(idx,1); saveEntries(all); renderEntries(); }
      });
      entriesEl.appendChild(div);
    });
  }
  function escapeHtml(s){
    var d = document.createElement('div');
    d.textContent = s;
    return d.innerHTML;
  }
  document.getElementById('saveEntry').addEventListener('click', function(){
    if(selectedMood === null){ return; }
    var note = document.getElementById('journalNote').value.trim();
    var list = loadEntries();
    list.push({ id: Date.now(), date: new Date().toISOString(), mood: selectedMood, note: note });
    saveEntries(list);
    document.getElementById('journalNote').value = '';
    selectedMood = null;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(moodRow.children, function(c){ c.classList.remove('selected'); });
    renderEntries();
  });
  renderEntries();

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
